title: Tellraw Translate Crash Defence
description: It stops people translate crashing you and also prevents out of memory errors.
body: Prevents people translate crashing you and prevents out of memory error kick, may make some tellraws over 200 chracters break. This mod helps to keep you alive on anarchy servers. Blocks all tellraw over 200 characters and helps you to prevent out of memory errors. The newer version blocks over 400 character messages and has a list of commands (located in changelog).
